name: Anuradhapura, Sri Lanka
elevationNote: Lowland plains, roughly 80–100 m above sea level
tagline: Paddy fields fed by monsoon rain and ancient village tanks
description: Anuradhapura is in Sri Lanka's Dry Zone. Most rain arrives with the northeast monsoon late in the year, and many farmers depend on reservoirs (tanks) to grow a second crop.
farmingContext: Rice is the main crop, grown in two seasons: Maha (main, wetter season) and Yala (secondary, drier season).
Yala cultivation often depends on how much water is stored in tanks after Maha.
Other field crops (such as mung bean and cowpea) are commonly grown on paddy land when water is short.

seasons.name: Maha
seasons.description: Main season, with rain from the northeast monsoon.

seasons.name: Yala
seasons.description: Secondary season; usually drier from June to September.
